title: Tornado Country In Minecraft
description: This project adds an old weather mod and improved world generation.
body:
# _What does the modpack add?_
The purpose of the build is to make the game more atmospheric and exciting. The main guest of the reset: The Weather, Storms & Tornadoes mod is a mod that significantly transforms the gameplay. He brings a variety of weather effects to the game, such as tornadoes, hurricanes and heavy rains. There are also new animals and a new generation of the world.

-----
# **Warning!**
- **It is not recommended to play on weak PCs!**
- **This modpack is not optimized (because it's old)**
- **I will no longer support this modpack**
-----
This modpack was published a year ago on my Minecraft Inside page, here is the link if anyone is interested - [My Minecraft Inside](https://minecraft-inside.ru/modpacks/185020-tornado-country-in-minecraft.html)
